description: This file defines a Java interface 'DeleteFeatureLiveCommandAnswerBuilder' along with nested interfaces for response and event factories related to handling delete feature commands within a live signal processing context. It specifies methods for constructing command responses and events for feature deletion operations, including error responses for various failure scenarios.

classes.name: DeleteFeatureLiveCommandAnswerBuilder
classes.description: Interface for building responses and events related to delete feature commands.

classes.name: ResponseFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating command responses such as success or error responses related to delete feature operations.

classes.name: EventFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating events triggered by delete feature commands, such as FeatureDeleted.

methods.name: deleted
methods.description: Constructs a successful delete feature response or event.

methods.name: featureNotAccessibleError
methods.description: Constructs an error response indicating the feature was not accessible.

methods.name: featureNotModifiableError
methods.description: Constructs an error response indicating the feature was not modifiable.

methods.name: deleted
methods.description: Creates a FeatureDeleted event indicating the feature was deleted.
